Do you compensate for a long delay?
We do not offer compensation for carrier or shipping delays, as shipping timeframes are estimates once an order has been handed off to the carrier.
If your shipment experiences a significant delay or shows no movement for more than 2 consecutive business days, please feel free to share your order number and email address so we can look into it for you.
